clauses: Count distinct transaction records (each trade record once), regardless of how many behaviour rows reference it.
Count advanced behaviour rows, so a trade record with several behaviour analyses is counted once per analysis.
readings: For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. Count distinct transaction records (each trade record once), regardless of how many behaviour rows reference it.

For each trader type, how many analysed trade records are there in the advanced behaviour data (only where the trade and its trader can be found), and what share of the overall total does each type make up? Keep the share unrounded. Count advanced behaviour rows, so a trade record with several behaviour analyses is counted once per analysis.
queries:
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS record_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
GROUP BY t.tradekind
